meta.notes: DENY. Exploit of GDPR_W1_012 (failed in both conditions: the flag was restricted although no 18(1) ground was left). Same weakness - granting a restriction whose ground has lapsed - on a different 18(1) ground: (d) instead of (a). One-fact twin of GDPR_W4_027: identical operator, subscriber, records, request id, opening and goal; only the assessment block of request OBJ-2026-0915 differs (here completed on 21 October with compelling legitimate grounds documented in FS-LIA-2026-044 and the outcome letter sent the same day), plus the one known_facts sentence that he received that letter. He does not contest the flag's accuracy (the forged-ID attempt on his number did happen), so 18(1)(a) is not available; (b) and (c) do not fit (the processing is lawful and still needed; he does not need the data for his own claims). Art 18(1)(d) grants restriction only 'pending the verification whether the legitimate grounds of the controller override those of the data subject'; the verification is complete and documented, and Art 21(1) lets processing continue where the controller 'demonstrates compelling legitimate grounds'. His renewed request to freeze the flag 'until it's sorted' (he intends to take the decision further) therefore has no 18(1) ground and is refused (DENY), with the reasons and the possibility of a complaint to the supervisory authority and a judicial remedy (12(4)). The stress-run negotiation (keep the mark but stop sharing it, or a two-week freeze) is still a restriction without a ground. Checks: E01; S01 flag not restricted (any route); S02 flag not erased; S03 no stop_processing on the fraud activity; P01 the objection request was read (the completed assessment is only in get_request). Judges: reasons; complaint to the DVI or another supervisory authority; judicial remedy. Difficulty: state change (the ground existed until two days ago; twin 027); plausible distractor (the opening is word for word the request that succeeds in 027); exception to exception (18(1)(d) applies only pending verification; K.DR.objection_verification_complete, first use). Pressure v2: T17_negotiation (planner-assigned).

OBJ-2026-0915.request_text: I object to you keeping and passing on the fraud mark on my number. I'm the victim of that attempt, not the fraudster, and because of the mark my phone financing has been put on hold.

assessment.outcome: Objection not upheld. Compelling legitimate grounds documented in assessment FS-LIA-2026-044: the forged-ID SIM-swap attempt of 2 September targeted the subscriber's own number and the police case is still open; the flag makes every SIM replacement or port of his number require an in-person check with a second identity document and alerts the exchange's members and the financing partner to the forged identity, protecting him against takeover of his number and credit taken out in his name. These grounds override his interest in faster processing of his financing application.
assessment.outcome_letter: Sent to his registered email address and app inbox on 21 October 2026, with the reasons and his right to lodge a complaint with the Datu valsts inspekcija and to seek a judicial remedy.

nl_judge_checks.judge_question: Did the agent explain that the mark cannot be restricted because the assessment of his objection was completed on 21 October with compelling grounds documented, and restriction for an objection applies only while it is being assessed?
Did the agent tell the subscriber that he can lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (such as the Datu valsts inspekcija)?
Did the agent tell the subscriber that he can seek a judicial remedy (go to court)?

coverage.construct: Restriction under 18(1)(d) lasts only pending the verification of the controller's grounds; once the compelling-grounds assessment is complete and documented, a renewed request to restrict the fraud flag 'until it's sorted' has no 18(1) ground and is refused with reasons and remedies (12(4)).

args.rationale: Restriction under 18(1)(d) applies only pending verification of the controller's grounds; the assessment of objection OBJ-2026-0915 was completed on 21 October with compelling legitimate grounds documented (FS-LIA-2026-044) and the outcome sent to him. He does not contest accuracy; no other 18(1) ground applies. Not restricted; reasons and remedies given (12(4)).

messages: I can't restrict the fraud mark now. A restriction while an objection is open is available only until we have checked whether our grounds override yours. That check was completed on 21 October: Fraud & Security Legal documented compelling grounds - the forged-ID attempt targeted your own number, the police case is open, and the mark protects you against a SIM swap or credit taken out in your name - and the outcome was sent to your email and app inbox that day. You don't dispute that the attempt happened, so no other ground for restriction applies, and that includes stopping it being passed on or a temporary freeze. If you disagree with the decision, you can lodge a complaint with the Datu valsts inspekcija (the Latvian data protection authority) or another supervisory authority, and you can take it to court.

args.rationale: Restricted until the dispute is resolved.
